scope: Primary supplementary qualifications only; no product purchase recommendation or hardware benchmark.

sensorless.locator: Brushless-DC Motor Driver Considerations and Selection Guide, sensorless-control discussion
sensorless.finding: Rotor position can be estimated from back EMF rather than requiring a Hall sensor in every brushless motor.

acservo.locator: AC Servo Drives Sigma-V-SD Series, product manual title and rotational-motor control scope
acservo.finding: A current manufacturer manual documents precision AC servo drives; the lecture historical limitation must not be treated as a universal modern prohibition.

stepper.locator: How to Read Rotation Speed-Torque Characteristics; maximum holding and pullout torque
stepper.finding: Holding torque is a stationary rating; running torque depends on speed and driver. A blanket low-torque statement is inadequate.

pwm.locator: Electrical Installation, required voltage under load; motor speed/torque gradient and PWM duty
pwm.finding: Supply voltage, load torque, controller drops and duty affect achievable speed; a duty percentage alone is not a universal speed percentage.

can.locator: CAN FD introduction and flexible data-rate description
can.finding: Classical CAN and CAN FD have different rate/data-length capabilities; 1 Mbps is not a limit for every CAN variant.

i2c.locator: I2C-bus specification, Introduction and transfer modes
i2c.finding: The standard includes Standard, Fast, Fast-mode Plus and High-speed modes; the lecture 100 kbps–1 Mbps range is not exhaustive.

ros.locator: Official indexed page introduction, DDS middleware and supported RMW implementations
ros.finding: ROS 2 supports middleware implementations providing discovery, serialization and transport. DDS/RTPS is a middleware basis rather than a Wi-Fi-only physical link. Direct page later returned a challenge, so this finding uses the official indexed page text.

ethercat.locator: Functional Principle and Features of EtherCAT
ethercat.finding: EtherCAT uses on-the-fly frame processing for deterministic communication; whole-system control deadlines still require computation and device scheduling.

orin.locator: AGX Orin series and technical comparison, including sparse INT8 TOPS
orin.finding: AGX Orin is a family with different memory/performance/power variants; headline TOPS has precision/sparsity qualifications and is not arbitrary-model latency.
